sources: Seeker of Dark Lung (WeaponBasicTable wpn_claym_0011). Skills 1–2 (Strength wpn_attr_str_mid, Ultimate Gain Efficiency wpn_sp_attr_usgs_mid) and skill 3's Main Attribute +primary_attr_up (rmxlinux SkillData sk_wpn_claym_0011 cardAttributeModifier formulaItem 6, modifyAttributeType 1) are stat-panel modifiers, not here.

Skill 3: "When the wielder applies an Arts Burst, the wielder gains ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s. Max stacks for effects of the same name: {max_stack}. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s." sk_wpn_claym_0011 passiveEventActions abilityEvent 127 (the wielder applies an Arts Burst, as in sk_wpn_funnel_0019) + CheckTimedMarkerCondition / CreateTimedMarker cd (0.1 s) → CreateBuff buff_wpn_claym_0011_atk_up_up on the wielder (attributeModifier ATK attr 2 formulaItem 6 +atk_up, duration 30 s, stackingType 2 with maxStackCntKey max_stack: independent layers). The buff file's max_stack 2 is overridden by the skill's (3 at every level, SkillPatchTable).
Its toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 and buff_wpn_claym_0011_primary01 are created by nothing (inert, as in wpn_funnel_0002 / wpn_lance_0010). No log has this weapon.

triggers.note: Each of the wielder's Arts Bursts (0.1 s timed marker cd), before that burst's damage, as Umbra of Frigid Eventide's trigger on the same abilityEvent 127 (wpn_funnel_0019: log dbaee23b801d t=8391); unverified for this weapon (test 51's question).
